caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic jar with a rounded body and a slightly narrower base. The jar is grey in color with blue decorative elements. It has two looped handles on either side, both accented with blue coloring where they attach to the body. On the front of the jar, there is a blue floral or abstract leaf-like design. The rim at the top of the jar features a pattern of blue lines and semi-circular motifs. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color. In the upper right corner of the drawing, the text "PAUL · CUSHMAN S" appears in blue uppercase letters within a rectangular box. At the bottom left, there is a small scale diagram labeled from 0 to 3.
title: Crock
